escape_underscores off leaves underscores in a table cell unescaped while escape_asterisks still applies

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{
		EscapeAsterisks:   true,
		EscapeUnderscores: false,
	}
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<table><tr><td>sample_value 2*3</td></tr></table>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
}
```
